title: Chapter 180 Plans Before Leaving
content:
Chapter 180 Plans Before Leaving

Not far away, Yan Yan looked at Hun Yue, who was so moved that he burst into tears, and immediately looked contemptuous.

"Tsk, you are a guy who has never seen the world."

At this time, the shout of the wild guard sounded again.

"Yan Yan."

"Here!"

Yan Yan stood straight and hurried forward, his expression was extremely respectful.

"Sir."

The wild guard glanced at Yan Yan, then smiled lightly and said: "You are not bad, you will be one of us in the future."

A delicate token was thrown into Yan Yan's hand.

It represented the identity of the wild guard of the wild city.

Suddenly, the information in the token poured into Yan Yan's consciousness like a tide.

Boom!

Yan Yan was stunned on the spot as if struck by lightning.

"This, this, this, this, "

"Woo woo woo, sir, from now on, Huangcheng is my home. Where Huangcheng is, Yan is there."

At this moment, Yan Yan wanted to kneel down directly to show his loyalty.

"Alright, alright."

The Huangwei looked at the reactions of the two and felt ashamed.

Is it that serious?

Is life outside so hard?

The Huangwei shook his head and continued to register.

At this time, in the Huangcheng City Lord's Mansion.

After settling the people of the Divine Dynasty, Yan Lingyun finally put her mind at ease.

"Xiaoxue, where is your father?"

At this time, Yan Lingyun asked Lu Xue.

Since I came back, I haven't seen the shadow of Lu Daosheng.

"My father? I don't know."

Lu Xue shook her head. She didn't know when her father ran away again.

However, since her father didn't tell her, he shouldn't have gone far.

"Lingyun, you're back."

Just as the two women were stunned, Lu Daosheng's voice rang out from the field.

The next moment, the two turned around and saw Lu Daosheng slowly walking from a distance.

"Where have you been?"

Yan Lingyun frowned slightly.

She didn't even know to pick him up when she came back.

But the next moment, she realized her little woman's thoughts and her face flushed slightly.

Looking at Yan Lingyun like this, Lu Daosheng was stunned for a moment, and then laughed.

"What are you laughing at!"

Yan Lingyun said shyly.

Seeing Yan Lingyun was a little angry, Lu Daosheng quickly restrained his smile and coughed lightly, "Lingyun, I went to an unknown star field."

I saw Lu Daosheng said seriously: "We are about to set off for the fairyland, so I naturally have to make more guarantees here."

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun's expression eased slightly.

"I need some resources to impact the fairyland."

Looking at Lu Daosheng, Yan Lingyun directly stretched out her hand.

I don't know when, I have become a beggar.

But since my man is so powerful, it's not too much for me to ask for a little.

Yan Lingyun thought so in her heart.

"Hey, Lingyun,"

Lu Daosheng smiled and then moved his face closer, the meaning was self-evident.

Suddenly, Yan Lingyun blushed and glanced at Lu Xue beside her without leaving a trace.

Lu Xue covered her eyes and murmured: "I, I didn't see anything."

Then, Lu Xue turned around and left quickly, and disappeared in a flash.

Watching Lu Xue leave.

Yan Lingyun directly slapped Lu Daosheng against the wall with one palm.

Bang!

"You guy, you are getting more and more daring."

Staring at Lu Daosheng with her eyes, Yan Lingyun gritted her teeth.

At this moment, the actions of the two became more ambiguous.

Seeing himself being pushed against the wall, Lu Daosheng swallowed his saliva, and at this moment, a pair of soft lips were imprinted on the corner of his mouth, and a tingling feeling spread all over his body.

When he opened his eyes again, he only saw Yan Lingyun tilting her head and standing in front of him shyly.

The sunset was imprinted on Yan Lingyun's cheek, adding a bit of beauty to her already delicate face.

At this moment, Lu Daosheng felt that he was the happiest man in the world.

Then, Lu Daosheng hugged Yan Lingyun in his arms.

"Lingyun, it's great to have you."

Hearing these mushy words, Yan Lingyun snorted, "Stop talking nonsense, give me the resources quickly."

After a while.

Looking at the ring in her hand, even Yan Lingyun, who had seen the world, was a little shocked.

"You, where did you get so much?"

"You don't often go out to rob, do you?"

Faced with Yan Lingyun's soul-searching questioning, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "Don't ask, if you ask, I picked it up."

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun rolled her eyes and turned away.

"When I come out of retreat, we will go to the fairyland."

Looking at Yan Lingyun's departing back, Lu Daosheng shook his head and smiled.

"Lingyun, in the fairyland, there are still surprises I prepared for you."

"Tsk, I don't know if Wanfeng is working well."

Then, Lu Daosheng's order came from the City Lord's Mansion.

The entire deserted city entered the final countdown.

Everyone knew that the city lord was going to take the Queen of the Divine Dynasty away from this world.

Some were happy and some were worried.

Inner city of the deserted city.

In a teahouse.

Several figures sat together, and the atmosphere was a bit dull.

"Brother Nangong, there will be big changes in Huangcheng soon. What are your plans?"

Hearing this, Nangong Fang said softly: "Wherever the city lord is, I will be there?"

"What about your family?"

Now, almost the entire Nangong family is in Huangcheng.

Nangong Fang has the opportunity to ascend with the city lord, but it is unrealistic to bring the whole family with him.

Just like last time.

In the Wanling Realm, the Nangong family spent a lot of effort to migrate all the Nangong family members in the Wanling Realm.

And this took almost thousands of years.

Now, the city lord is leaving again.

It is easy for those who are alone, but it is a bit difficult for people like Nangong Fang who have a family behind him.

Hearing this, Nangong Fang was silent for a moment and said in a low voice: "I have contacted people from the three major families."

"Although I can't bring the entire Nangong family, I can still bring the core members and some talented clansmen."

"This is also the last time."

Hearing this, the people around looked a little surprised.

"Brother Nangong is righteous, but don't you think we are leaving a little too fast?"

At this time, Shi Tianzhi spoke.

Everyone was silent when they heard this.

Although they had made contributions and were able to move into the inner city when the deserted city was first built, they are now gradually feeling the strain.

The pace is too fast and some can't keep up.

Nowadays, most of them are around the God Emperor realm, and they have used a lot of resources to pile up.

If it weren't for the special environment of the deserted city, their realm would be even worse.

After a long time, the drunk old man who had not spoken a word said slowly: "I don't plan to go to the upper realm with the city lord."

As soon as these words came out, everyone immediately looked at the drunk old man.

The drunk old man continued: "Do you still remember Broken Sword? That guy has the courage to go out on his own, so why should I be afraid."
